selected.name: The Cabin Postcard · Whole Cabin
selected.idea: The whole cabin is visible in a real wider sunny exterior photo, framed without cropping.
selected.emotion: The familiar warmth of a little cedar coffee cabin.
selected.composition: Full 4:3 exterior photo, large straight frame and smaller title. Cartoon sticker removed with built-in image editor; four-image lower gallery retained. Local review only.
selected.motion: The straight framed print arrives vertically once; title and actions settle, then stillness by 2.2 seconds.
selected.note: Approved: straight postcard, full-cabin photo with the cartoon sticker removed, larger image and smaller title, and four-photo gallery.

selected.name: An Open Door
selected.idea: A generous arched doorway puts the familiar dining room at the heart of the welcome.
selected.emotion: The easy warmth of stepping inside a place that already feels familiar.
selected.composition: A red field carries large cream invitation type at left; a tall cream-lined photographic doorway at right preserves the real lantern and booths. Phone places the short welcome above the doorway and the invitation below.
selected.motion: The doorway opens from its center while the welcome settles once; final by 1.8 seconds.
selected.note: Approved by you: An Open Door from the new restaurant set, as the complete website.

selected.name: Magnolia Morning
selected.idea: The real magnolia canopy becomes the invitation, with a quiet cream nameplate beside it.
selected.emotion: Fresh air, a familiar stop and a slower breath before the day.
selected.composition: An edge-to-edge photograph fills the right three-fifths; oversized rose Tinos lettering lives on a narrow cream column that steps into the image. On phones the full hut sits below the name.
selected.motion: The photo opens like a wide curtain, the two brand lines rise into place, and a fine rose line draws once; settled by 2.2 seconds.
selected.note: Approved by you: option 1, Magnolia Morning, as the complete website.

selected.name: The Living Wall
selected.idea: The real neon sign glows within an immersive, edge-to-edge wall of green leaves.
selected.emotion: A lush, private retreat; the studio identity is the entire first impression.
selected.composition: Unframed real signage and foliage cover the whole hero, with a restrained invitation along the bottom. On phones, the actual sign photograph is kept wide enough to show the full lettering, and cropped foliage from that same photo extends the green wall below.
selected.motion: The actual photograph brightens once as the lavender light softly blooms across the foliage; the bottom invitation settles, fully still by 2.35 seconds.
selected.note: Approved by you: option 1, The Living Wall, as the complete website.

selected.name: Entirely Yours · Studio
selected.idea: A warm, clear view of the actual GLO studio fills the larger accepted photo frame.
selected.emotion: Personal attention and room to breathe.
selected.composition: Split serif headline above and below a larger centered photo of the real tan-chair studio, softened corners and a fine gold frame; no blurred side fill or extra image zoom. Phone shows the full square room photo.
selected.motion: The frame opens horizontally, its gold contour follows, and the booking invitation rises gently.
selected.note: Approved: larger frame and new real tan-chair studio photo, centered naturally without blurred side fill.

selected.name: Extra Good · Cream & Coffee
selected.idea: The chosen second layout and approved latte photo, on warm cream with coffee-brown accents.
selected.emotion: The cheerful pick-me-up of a favorite drink: expressive, lively and a little indulgent.
selected.composition: Warm cream canvas, large coffee-brown wordmark, an angled real coffee-and-muffin photograph, bold side typography, fine graphic accents and a deeper cream location strip. Layout and framing are unchanged; on phones a two-line masthead leads into the large diagonal photograph.
selected.motion: The masthead arrives first, the coffee-and-muffin print glides in and settles at a slight angle, and side lettering steps into place once; everything stops by 1.9 seconds.
selected.note: Approved by you: option 2 with the latte photo and cream-and-coffee background.

selected.name: The Color Studio · Warm Stone
selected.idea: The same dimensional color-book composition, now on a softly lit warm-stone background.
selected.emotion: Creative hands, considered color, and the excitement of choosing a fresh look.
selected.composition: A large open sample book floats at a deliberate angle over a softly lit warm-stone backdrop. A whole result photograph is its central page, surrounded by fanned sage, oak and cream leaves; bold red name lettering grounds the other side.
selected.motion: The fanned leaves turn open in a short stagger, the result page settles into place, and the salon name wipes in once; settled by 2.6 seconds.
selected.note: Approved by you: option 3 with the refined warm-stone background.

selected.name: Stay a Little Longer
selected.idea: A panoramic cafe journal pairs monumental plum typography with a sweeping ribbon of the real room and its people-first coffee ritual.
selected.emotion: Belonging: the generous, art-filled cafe you come for and the comfortable room you stay in.
selected.composition: Wide cream masthead with an enormous left-aligned wordmark and right-aligned invitation; below, a full-width three-panel photographic ribbon of fireplace, coffee and cafe interior. A solid plum action rail closes the hero. On mobile the masthead is stacked above the photographic triptych.
selected.motion: Three photographs unfold upward in sequence, like opening a cafe journal; the large wordmark settles above them. Motion is complete by 1.85 seconds.
selected.note: Approved by you: option 3, Stay a Little Longer, as the complete website.

selected.name: Where the Night Begins
selected.idea: The cinematic room of The Night Opens meets the bold maroon roadside character of Off the Highway.
selected.emotion: The confidence of a familiar landmark, and the warm pull of the night waiting inside.
selected.composition: A monumental cream-and-amber Roundup masthead on maroon, a wide cream-framed panorama of the actual room, and a strong roadside invitation. It combines the two selected ideas without adding a second competing photo.
selected.motion: The two parts of the masthead arrive from opposite sides, the room opens from the center and the framed panorama settles gently into place. The invitation completes the arrival at 2.35 seconds; all motion then stops.
selected.note: Approved by you: option 3, Where the Night Begins, as the complete website.
